# sanity_webhook (Resource)

Provides a Sanity webhook. Webhooks allow you to get notified when content is created, updated, or deleted in your Sanity project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sanity_webhook" "example" {
  project_id     = sanity_project.example.id
  name           = "Content Updates Webhook"
  dataset        = "production"
  url            = "https://api.example.com/webhooks/sanity"
  http_method    = "POST"
  include_drafts = false
  filter         = "_type == 'post'"

  headers = {
    "Authorization" = "Bearer ${var.api_token}"
    "Content-Type"  = "application/json"
  }

  secret = var.webhook_secret
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for webhook authentication"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "webhook_secret" {
  description = "Secret for webhook signature verification"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) The dataset this webhook is configured for.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name for the webhook.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID that this webhook belongs to.
- `url` (String) The endpoint URL that will receive webhook notifications.

### Optional

- `api_version` (String) The API version used for webhook payloads. Defaults to the current API version.
- `filter` (String) A GROQ filter expression to determine which documents trigger the webhook.
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers sent with webhook requests.
- `http_method` (String) The HTTP method used for webhook requests. Defaults to `POST`.
- `include_drafts` (Boolean) Whether draft documents trigger webhook notifications. Defaults to `false`.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is currently disabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret used for webhook signature verification.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) The webhook ID.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the webhook was last updated.
